title: Application of Nantucket Electric Company to the Department of Public Utilities, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, §§ 94 and 94A, and applicable rules and regulations of the Department, for approval of the power purchase contract by and between said company and Pizzagalli Property Company and related transactions, as any be necessary. Approval is also sought for any such other action, under any such other statute, as may be deemed necessary or appropriate in connection with the foregoing.
petitioner: Nantucket Electric Company d/b/a National Grid
